images.name: meal_plans
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE premium compact 3D illustration asset for the Nabvera nutrition app. Cohesive series art direction: softly rounded forms, refined matte ceramic materials, restrained electric blue #3D7BFF and royal blue #2B5FE0, pale cool neutral accents and small mint #29D9C0 details. Soft upper-left studio lighting, subtle ambient occlusion, polished product illustration, elegant adult wellness app aesthetic, not childish. Isolated on a genuinely transparent background, no colored backdrop or environment. Square composition, central object cluster fills 75% of canvas with generous safe margins. Readable at 80px thumbnail scale, few clear shapes, no unnecessary tiny details. NO text, letters, numerals, logos, watermarks, app UI or border. Subject: a blue weekly calendar standing at a slight three-quarter angle behind a compact off-white bento meal container. Calendar has simple unnumbered recessed grid squares, two small binder rings and one mint checkmark. Bento contains simplified appetizing broccoli florets, a portion of rice and a small grilled chicken piece, clearly a generic balanced meal illustration. Calendar is dominant, food secondary. Calm organized composition.
